title: How Elon Musk Engineered the World’s Biggest I.P.O.

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最强的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 现在订阅可享受优惠，请访问 nytimes.com/subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: On Monday, the AI giant Anthropic filed paperwork to go public,
sentences.zh: 周一，人工智能巨头Anthropic提交了上市申请，

sentences.en: turbocharging a coming wave of blockbuster IPOs that could mint the world's first trillionaire and remake American capitalism.
sentences.zh: 这为即将到来的大规模IPO浪潮注入了强心剂，可能造就全球首位万亿富翁，并重塑美国资本主义。

sentences.en: The first of those IPOs will be Elon Musk's SpaceX, set to begin selling shares as soon as next week.
sentences.zh: 其中首个IPO将是埃隆·马斯克的SpaceX，预计最快下周开始发售股票。

sentences.en: Today, business reporter Ryan Mack takes us inside the plan for SpaceX's record-shattering debut on the stock market and explains how it's already changing the rules for investing
sentences.zh: 今天，商业记者瑞安·麦克将带我们深入了解SpaceX在股市上打破纪录的上市计划，并解释它如何改变投资规则，

sentences.en: in ways that mean its success or failure will affect all of us.
sentences.zh: 其成功或失败将影响我们所有人。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, June 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月2日，星期二。

sentences.en: Ryan, welcome to the show.
sentences.zh: 瑞安，欢迎来到节目。

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: My pleasure.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: A confession here.
sentences.zh: 先坦白一下。

sentences.en: It's very rare for The Daily to cover an IPO.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》很少报道IPO。

sentences.en: And that's because it's pretty rare that an IPO generates a level of interest and excitement and worry that the one we're going to talk to you about today does.
sentences.zh: 这是因为很少有IPO能像我们今天要讨论的这个一样，引发如此高的关注、兴奋和担忧。

sentences.en: So my first question to you is, why does this initial public offering of SpaceX matter so much and feel so monumental to so many people?
sentences.zh: 所以我的第一个问题是，为什么SpaceX的这次首次公开募股如此重要，让这么多人觉得意义非凡？

sentences.en: I think it has everything to do with Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 我认为这完全与埃隆·马斯克有关，

sentences.en: SpaceX's founder and CEO.
sentences.zh: 他是SpaceX的创始人兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: And like everything with Elon Musk, this IPO is singular.
sentences.zh: 和埃隆·马斯克的一切一样，这次IPO是独一无二的。

sentences.en: It's likely going to be the largest of all time, raising anywhere from $50 to $75 billion.
sentences.zh: 它很可能成为史上规模最大的IPO，筹资额在500亿到750亿美元之间。

sentences.en: It's going to value this company likely at more than $1.25 trillion.
sentences.zh: 它可能会让这家公司的估值超过1.25万亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And it could make Elon Musk, already the richest man in the world, already one of the most powerful people in the world, the world's first trillionaire.
sentences.zh: 这可能会让已经是世界首富、也是世界上最有权势的人之一的埃隆·马斯克，成为全球首位万亿富翁。

sentences.en: And this opportunity to invest in this kind of one-of-a-kind company,
sentences.zh: 而投资这种独一无二公司的机会，

sentences.en: I think that excites a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我想这让很多人感到兴奋。

sentences.en: It is a rocket manufacturer.
sentences.zh: 它是一家火箭制造商。

sentences.en: It launches things into space for the government and for private companies.
sentences.zh: 它为政府和私营公司发射航天器。

sentences.en: And it's also got this artificial intelligence bent to it as well.
sentences.zh: 而且它还具有人工智能的属性。

sentences.en: And what you're going to see in this IPO is a large involvement of retail or mom-and-pop investors
sentences.zh: 在这次IPO中，你会看到大量的散户或普通投资者参与其中，

sentences.en: who are excited to invest in a company they see as run by a generational entrepreneur.
sentences.zh: 他们很兴奋能投资一家由时代级企业家经营的公司。

sentences.en: Well, why is Musk trying to raise this money right now and through the method of an IPO?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么马斯克现在要通过IPO这种方式来筹集资金呢？

sentences.en: You don't have to make a company public to raise a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 公司上市并不是筹集大量资金的唯一途径。

sentences.en: There are all kinds of ways to raise money.
sentences.zh: 筹集资金的方法有很多种。

sentences.en: You don't have to take it public, but this company has been private for more than 20 years.
sentences.zh: 你不一定要上市，但这家公司已经私有化超过20年了。

sentences.en: It was founded in 2002, and it's raised a lot of money already on the private markets from venture capitalists, from private equity funds.
sentences.zh: 它成立于2002年，已经在私募市场上从风险投资家和私募股权基金那里筹集了大量资金。

sentences.en: So as a company, you kind of get one shot to do this in your lifetime, to raise money on the public market for the first time.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一家公司，你一生中大概只有一次机会在公开市场上首次筹集资金。

sentences.en: And so Elon Musk sees this as his opportunity to do that and to raise these tens of billions of dollars to fund a lot of the goals that SpaceX has for the next 10, 20, 30 years.
sentences.zh: 因此，埃隆·马斯克将其视为实现这一目标的机会，筹集数百亿美元，为SpaceX未来10年、20年、30年的许多目标提供资金。

sentences.en: You must have solar-powered AI satellites in deep space.
sentences.zh: 你必须在深空拥有太阳能人工智能卫星。

sentences.en: So this is where it's kind of handy to have a space company, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，拥有一家太空公司在这里就派上用场了。

sentences.en: I'm talking about visions to launch data centers into space for AI.
sentences.zh: 我说的是将人工智能数据中心发射到太空的愿景。

sentences.en: You can mine a silicon on the moon, refine it, and create the solar panels, or the solar cells and the radiators.
sentences.zh: 你可以在月球上开采硅，提炼它，制造太阳能电池板，或者太阳能电池和散热器。

sentences.en: I'm talking about landing humans on the moon and building factories to do mining.
sentences.zh: 我说的是让人类登陆月球并建立工厂进行采矿。

sentences.en: We are going to be able to take astronauts to Mars and ultimately build a self-sustaining civilization on Mars.
sentences.zh: 我们将能够把宇航员送上火星，并最终在火星上建立一个自给自足的文明。

sentences.en: That is the long-term goal of the company.
sentences.zh: 这是该公司的长期目标。

sentences.en: Ultimately, he's talked about making humans multi-planetary, getting them to Mars and making us a species that exists on more than one planet.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，他谈到的是让人类成为多行星物种，把他们送到火星，让我们成为一个存在于不止一颗行星上的物种。

sentences.en: It is very important, essential, that over the long term, that we become a multi-planet species and ultimately even go beyond the solar system and bring life with us.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，我们成为多行星物种，并最终超越太阳系并将生命带去那里，这是非常重要且必要的。

sentences.en: Right, those very modest goals.
sentences.zh: 没错，真是非常“谦虚”的目标。

sentences.en: Yes, very modest goals.
sentences.zh: 是的，非常谦虚的目标。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you're saying that those kinds of literally otherworldly business goals require the kind of money that you cannot just go to Wells Fargo and get from the bank.
sentences.zh: 听起来你是说，那些字面上“超凡脱俗”的商业目标，需要的资金是你不能随便去富国银行找银行贷款就能解决的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm sure that Elon is not necessarily going under his couch cushions and scrounging for change here.
sentences.zh: 是的，我敢肯定埃隆不会去翻沙发垫找零钱。

sentences.en: We are talking about huge, vast sums of money that don't come around very often.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的是巨大、庞大的资金，这种机会并不常有。

sentences.en: Bear in mind as well that we have these other companies also trying to raise money.
sentences.zh: 还要记住，我们还有其他公司也在试图筹集资金。

sentences.en: I'm talking about OpenAI, Anthropic as well, that are looking to go public and raise also tens of billions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 我说的是OpenAI和Anthropic，它们也都在寻求上市并筹集数百亿美元。

sentences.en: And so there's kind of this element of who can get out fastest and, you know, raise money from the investor because there's only so much money out there to raise.
sentences.zh: 所以这里存在一种竞争，看谁能最快行动，从投资者那里筹集资金，因为市场上的资金毕竟有限。

sentences.en: Right, and so far, Musk will be firSt.
sentences.zh: 没错，到目前为止，马斯克会是第一个。

sentences.en: He will.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He will.
sentences.zh: 他会是第一个。

sentences.en: And it's now a question of convincing the investors that SpaceX, which has now a large AI component to it, is indeed a better bet than, let's say, Anthropic or OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是说服投资者，SpaceX——现在拥有庞大的人工智能业务——确实比Anthropic或OpenAI更好的投资选择。

sentences.en: You describe this as a chance for mom-and-pop investors to become a part of this IPO.
sentences.zh: 你把这描述为散户投资者参与这次IPO的机会。

sentences.en: That's not the way I typically think of a company going public.
sentences.zh: 这通常不是我理解的公司上市的方式。

sentences.en: I think of big banks like Morgan Stanley or Goldman Sachs, not you and me and our moms and dads.
sentences.zh: 我想到的是摩根士丹利或高盛这样的大银行，而不是你我以及我们的父母。

sentences.en: So these mom-and-pop investors, something the industry likes to call retail investors,
sentences.zh: 所以这些散户投资者，也就是业内喜欢称呼的“零售投资者”，

sentences.en: get an opportunity to invest here through their brokerage accounts like Charles Schwab or Robinhood.
sentences.zh: 可以通过他们的经纪账户，如嘉信理财或Robinhood，获得投资机会。

sentences.en: Typically, you get 5% to 10% of shares in an IPO reserve for retail.
sentences.zh: 通常，IPO中会有5%到10%的股份预留给散户。

sentences.en: There's discussion now of about 30% being allowed to retail.
sentences.zh: 现在有讨论说要将这一比例提高到30%左右。

sentences.en: So three times more.
sentences.zh: 也就是三倍多。

sentences.en: That's meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这意义重大。

sentences.en: And why is Musk making this stock so much more available than normal to your regular retail investor than most companies that are going public?
sentences.zh: 为什么马斯克要让普通散户比大多数上市公司更容易获得这些股票？

sentences.en: I think it's just the sheer size of this thing.
sentences.zh: 我认为这仅仅是因为它的规模太大了。

sentences.en: It's going to need investors beyond your traditional banks and funds that typically put their money into IPOs.
sentences.zh: 它需要的投资者不仅仅是那些通常投资IPO的传统银行和基金。

sentences.en: And it's also going to need a hefty base of investors to continue believing in this company and holding its shares.
sentences.zh: 它还需要一个庞大的投资者基础来持续相信这家公司并持有其股票。

sentences.en: And so Elon Musk over the years has been pretty brilliant in his strategy of courting the everyday person.
sentences.zh: 所以埃隆·马斯克多年来在争取普通人方面的策略非常高明。

sentences.en: And he's building on that to attract retail investors here and build this hype.
sentences.zh: 他正在此基础上吸引散户投资者并制造这种炒作。

sentences.en: You know, he is always on Twitter, for example, or on X these days, tweeting and building essentially a community of people,
sentences.zh: 你知道，他总是活跃在Twitter上，或者说现在的X上，发推文并建立了一个社区，

sentences.en: of fans, of folks that are just interested in his companies and in him.
sentences.zh: 由粉丝、对他的公司和他本人感兴趣的人组成。

sentences.en: And he wants to give those people an opportunity to inveSt.
sentences.zh: 他想给这些人一个投资的机会。

sentences.en: Because once this thing IPOs, it's going to need shareholders to sustain it and to own it and to continue investing in it.
sentences.zh: 因为一旦上市，它就需要股东来维持、拥有并继续投资它。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Basically, Elon Musk needs regular investors for this to work.
sentences.zh: 基本上，埃隆·马斯克需要普通投资者来让这一切运作起来。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But even if you don't want to own SpaceX shares or if you avoid this IPO,
sentences.zh: 但即使你不想拥有SpaceX的股票，或者你避开了这次IPO，

sentences.en: you may essentially end up owning a part of SpaceX indirectly.
sentences.zh: 你最终也可能间接持有SpaceX的一部分。

sentences.en: And how is that?
sentences.zh: 那是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Why would that be?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: So, like many Americans, you know, you and I have investments in retirement funds.
sentences.zh: 就像许多美国人一样，你和我都有退休基金投资。

sentences.en: And, you know, these retirement funds are often invested in index funds, which are a collection of companies and stocks that are meant to mirror American industry.
sentences.zh: 这些退休基金通常投资于指数基金，这是一系列旨在反映美国工业的公司和股票的集合。

sentences.en: So, for example, the NASDAQ 100 is a collection of 100 companies and their stocks trade publicly.
sentences.zh: 例如，纳斯达克100指数是100家公司及其公开交易股票的集合。

sentences.en: And so, you may own a chunk of the NASDAQ 100.
sentences.zh: 所以，你可能持有一部分纳斯达克100指数基金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The NASDAQ 100 is relaxing its rules to allow for SpaceX to enter the index a lot more quickly than in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 纳斯达克100指数正在放宽规则，允许SpaceX比过去更快地进入指数。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Typically, what happens is that when a company goes public, its stock needs about three months on the public market for a cooling off period.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，当一家公司上市时，其股票需要在公开市场上经历大约三个月的冷静期。

sentences.en: And that's because there's fluctuations in stock prices.
sentences.zh: 这是因为股价会有波动。

sentences.en: You kind of want to see where investors settle out with the stock, you know, if it goes up or down.
sentences.zh: 你希望观察投资者对股票的反应，看它是涨还是跌。

sentences.en: And after that three months, typically you get the thumbs up and you get to enter the index.
sentences.zh: 三个月后，通常会获得批准并进入指数。

sentences.en: What's happening here instead is that after just 15 days of trading with SpaceX, so 15 days after the IPO,
sentences.zh: 而这里发生的情况是，SpaceX在交易仅15天后，也就是IPO后15天，

sentences.en: SpaceX will be added to the NASDAQ 100 and essentially force the funds that trade off the NASDAQ 100 to buy shares of the company, to mirror essentially what's in the index.
sentences.zh: SpaceX就会被加入纳斯达克100指数，这实际上迫使那些基于纳斯达克100交易的基金购买该公司股票，以反映指数的构成。

sentences.en: What that does for SpaceX is that it gives the company way more money and way more investors to work with.
sentences.zh: 这对SpaceX的作用是，它为公司提供了更多的资金和更多的投资者。

sentences.en: So you're essentially getting access to billions of dollars that you wouldn't necessarily have access to.
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上获得了原本无法获得的数十亿美元资金。

sentences.en: And, you know, shareholders that are already going to own your stock because of this index opportunity.
sentences.zh: 而且，由于这个指数机会，股东们无论如何都会持有你的股票。

sentences.en: This is kind of fascinating.
sentences.zh: 这真令人着迷。

sentences.en: Why are these indexes relaxing, changing, making more elastic their rules for SpaceX?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些指数要为SpaceX放宽、改变、增加规则的弹性？

sentences.en: Is that their own decision or is that at the urging of Musk and SpaceX?
sentences.zh: 这是他们自己的决定，还是在马斯克和SpaceX的敦促下做出的？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: I think it's a bit of both.
sentences.zh: 我认为两者都有。

sentences.en: For Musk and SpaceX, they get access to a lot of capital, billions of dollars worth that they wouldn't have had access to without these rule changes,
sentences.zh: 对于马斯克和SpaceX来说，他们获得了大量资本，价值数十亿美元，如果没有这些规则变更，他们本无法获得，

sentences.en: or they would have had to wait much longer to get access to that.
sentences.zh: 或者他们必须等待更长时间才能获得。

sentences.en: For the indexes, there is a fear of missing out here, a FOMO that, you know,
sentences.zh: 对于指数来说，这里存在一种错失恐惧症（FOMO），

sentences.en: they could be missing out on these potential gains for their investors in this kind of once-in-a-lifetime IPO.
sentences.zh: 他们担心会错过这种一生一次的IPO中为投资者带来的潜在收益。

sentences.en: And that has frightened a lot of experts.
sentences.zh: 这让许多专家感到害怕。

sentences.en: You know, I talked to one, for example, who said, it's like creating rules for football.
sentences.zh: 我采访过一位专家，他说，这就像制定足球规则一样。

sentences.en: And right before you get to the Super Bowl, you throw some of those rules out the window.
sentences.zh: 就在超级碗比赛前夕，你把一些规则扔出了窗外。

sentences.en: You know, you've created these rules of the road here that have simply been eliminated at this kind of monumental event.
sentences.zh: 你制定了这些游戏规则，却在这样一个重大事件中被简单地废除了。

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting, right?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣，对吧？

sentences.en: On one level, being invested in something that you don't anticipate or necessarily desire being invested in feels risky, just inherently.
sentences.zh: 一方面，投资于你并不预期或不一定渴望投资的东西，本质上感觉是有风险的。

sentences.en: On the other hand, if this IPO is a huge financial success, then lots of people will be benefiting from it more rapidly than they would have in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，如果这次IPO在财务上取得巨大成功，那么很多人将比过去更快地从中受益。

sentences.en: That makes me think about Google's IPO.
sentences.zh: 这让我想到了谷歌的IPO。

sentences.en: We all wish we had been invested in Google when it went public.
sentences.zh: 我们都希望在谷歌上市时就投资了它。

sentences.en: I think it was up something like 80% in its first six months on the market.
sentences.zh: 我想它在上市的前六个月里上涨了大约80%。

sentences.en: Probably wasn't on these indexes either.
sentences.zh: 当时它可能也不在这些指数里。

sentences.en: Perhaps we wish it had been.
sentences.zh: 也许我们希望它当时就在。

sentences.en: And in this case, SpaceX will be, which could be a boon.
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，SpaceX会进入，这可能是一个福音。

sentences.en: I think when numbers go up, everyone is happy.
sentences.zh: 我认为当数字上涨时，每个人都很高兴。

sentences.en: You know, everyone gets to celebrate and, you know, take part in the win.
sentences.zh: 每个人都能庆祝并分享胜利的果实。

sentences.en: But there's no guarantee that this necessarily goes up.
sentences.zh: 但不能保证它一定会涨。

sentences.en: And what happens if shares start to fall after the first couple days of trading?
sentences.zh: 如果交易头几天后股价开始下跌会怎样？

sentences.en: You know, you mentioned Google there.
sentences.zh: 你提到了谷歌。

sentences.en: But I think of something like Facebook when it went public.
sentences.zh: 但我想到的是Facebook上市时的情况。

sentences.en: And the trials and tribulations it faced, you know, its stock went down shortly thereafter.
sentences.zh: 它面临的磨难，你知道，它的股价在上市后不久就下跌了。

sentences.en: Of course, it's gone up many times over since that time.
sentences.zh: 当然，从那时起它已经上涨了很多倍。

sentences.en: But in those first early days of trading, there were a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 但在交易的最初几天，确实有很多疑问。

sentences.en: If SpaceX doesn't hit its milestones or some of these very pie-in-the-sky goals that Elon Musk has set out for the company,
sentences.zh: 如果SpaceX没有达到其里程碑，或者埃隆·马斯克为公司设定的那些非常遥不可及的目标，

sentences.en: you may have a lot of investors asking, why was this allowed?
sentences.zh: 你可能会有很多投资者问，为什么允许这样做？

sentences.en: Why am I holding this stock?
sentences.zh: 我为什么要持有这只股票？

sentences.en: Why was it in these indexes to begin with?
sentences.zh: 为什么它一开始就在这些指数里？

sentences.en: So quite clearly, the story of this IPO so far is how clearly it's seeking to put this stock, put a piece of SpaceX into the hands of a lot of regular people.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，这次IPO的故事到目前为止，就是它如何明确地寻求将这只股票、将SpaceX的一部分交到许多普通人手中。

sentences.en: And that, of course, means that if this is a great IPO, the upside for lots and lots of people is going to be unusually spread out.
sentences.zh: 当然，这意味着如果这是一次成功的首次公开募股（IPO），那么对于许许多多的人来说，其上涨空间将会异常分散。

sentences.en: But if it goes south and is bad, then the pain is going to be felt by a lot larger group of people than normal.
sentences.zh: 但如果情况恶化，表现糟糕，那么痛苦将由比平时多得多的人群来承担。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: When you think about that, you have to think about what kind of business is essentially holding up those valuations.
sentences.zh: 当你思考这一点时，你必须考虑究竟是什么样的业务在支撑着这些估值。

sentences.en: With an IPO, every company has to file what's called an S-1 to disclose their financial health and their projections for the future.
sentences.zh: 对于IPO，每家公司都必须提交所谓的S-1文件，以披露其财务健康状况和未来预测。

sentences.en: And so I've been covering Elon Musk for many years now.
sentences.zh: 我报道埃隆·马斯克已经很多年了。

sentences.en: This is the first time I've been able to see the full picture of what's going on at SpaceX.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次能够全面了解SpaceX内部正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: And after spending a couple of days with this document, which is 277 pages, I and many others just have a lot of questions as to whether or not the business that we're seeing here,
sentences.zh: 在研读了这份277页的文件几天后，我和许多其他人一样，对我们在这里看到的业务是否真的能支撑人们投资的万亿美元估值，产生了许多疑问。

sentences.en: the numbers that it's putting up, can justify these trillion dollar valuations that people will be investing in.
sentences.zh: 以及它所呈现出的数据是否足以支撑这些万亿美元的估值。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你听到的那些人制作的。

sentences.en: So, Ryan, now that you have spent time with this nearly 300-page document and you've peeked behind the curtain of SpaceX's actual business,
sentences.zh: 那么，瑞安，既然你已经花时间研究了这份近300页的文件，并且窥探了SpaceX实际业务的幕后，

sentences.en: how healthy a business have you concluded that it is or isn't as everyone is deciding whether or not to participate in its IPO?
sentences.zh: 在大家都在决定是否参与其IPO之际，你认为这家公司的业务到底有多健康？

sentences.en: I think the answer to that is that it's quite complicated.
sentences.zh: 我认为答案是：情况相当复杂。

sentences.en: There are some positives about this business and there are a lot of question marks or negatives about this business as well.
sentences.zh: 这项业务既有一些积极因素，也存在许多问号或负面因素。

sentences.en: All right, we'll start with the positive.
sentences.zh: 好的，我们先从积极的一面说起。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: So let's start with the crown jewel of the company, which right now appears to be Starlink.
sentences.zh: 让我们从公司的皇冠明珠开始，目前看来就是星链（Starlink）。

sentences.en: This is the company's satellite internet service.
sentences.zh: 这是该公司的卫星互联网服务。

sentences.en: The company has launched these satellites that circle the Earth and the satellites beam down internet service to people on the ground.
sentences.zh: 公司发射了这些环绕地球运行的卫星，卫星将互联网服务传送到地面用户手中。

sentences.en: It's now racked up about 10 million users and about $4.4 billion in profit last year.
sentences.zh: 它去年已经积累了约1000万用户，利润约为44亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow, that's enormous.
sentences.zh: 哇，那真是太庞大了。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a very healthy business.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是一项非常健康的业务。

sentences.en: And that's because the company dominates the launch business.
sentences.zh: 这得益于该公司在发射业务上的垄断地位。

sentences.en: That was essentially the business that SpaceX was founded on, this idea that it could privatize rocket launches,
sentences.zh: 这本质上是SpaceX成立的基础业务，即它能够将火箭发射私有化，

sentences.en: essentially, that were owned by NASA and the government at the time.
sentences.zh: 而这些发射在当时是由NASA和政府掌控的。

sentences.en: And that bet has paid off well.
sentences.zh: 那个赌注押对了。

sentences.en: You know, the company now dominates that market.
sentences.zh: 你知道，该公司现在垄断了那个市场。

sentences.en: There are estimates that it does more than 85% of all mass into orbit from Earth is through a SpaceX rocket.
sentences.zh: 据估计，地球上超过85%进入轨道的载荷都是通过SpaceX火箭完成的。

sentences.en: And from that, it's been able to build up Starlink as well.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，它也得以建立起星链业务。

sentences.en: And so you get this kind of very healthy business off those two things.
sentences.zh: 所以你从这两项业务中得到了这种非常健康的经营状况。

sentences.en: Okay, and where are the question marks slash serious risks?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么那些问号或者说严重风险在哪里呢？

sentences.en: So the question marks are stemming from the company's investment into AI.
sentences.zh: 问号源于公司对人工智能的投资。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, you had SpaceX merge with Elon Musk's AI company, XAI.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，SpaceX与埃隆·马斯克的人工智能公司xAI进行了合并。

sentences.en: And at the time, Musk justified it as the convergence of synergies.
sentences.zh: 当时，马斯克将其合理化为协同效应的融合。

sentences.en: He saw the future of AI taking part in space.
sentences.zh: 他预见到人工智能的未来将在太空发挥作用。

sentences.en: And that's because he believed that these AI data centers, which take up a lot of land and resources on Earth, should be put into orbit, where they'll have easier access to energy,
sentences.zh: 这是因为他相信，这些在地球上占用大量土地和资源的人工智能数据中心，应该被放置在轨道上，在那里它们可以更容易地获取能源，

sentences.en: they'll be closer to the sun, and where they won't take up as many resources as they would on Earth.
sentences.zh: 它们离太阳更近，而且不会像在地球上那样占用那么多资源。

sentences.en: Basically, data centers in the sky.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就是天上的数据中心。

sentences.en: Data centers in the sky, circling the Earth.
sentences.zh: 天上的数据中心，环绕着地球。

sentences.en: You know, that was the vision for this merger.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这就是这次合并的愿景。

sentences.en: And bolting on that AI company onto this successful space company has caused financial strain.
sentences.zh: 将那家人工智能公司挂靠在这家成功的太空公司上，造成了财务压力。

sentences.en: The company's capital expenditures doubled to $20.7 billion in 2024.
sentences.zh: 2024年，公司的资本支出翻了一番，达到207亿美元。

sentences.en: In 2025, it recorded a $4.3 billion loss across its whole business.
sentences.zh: 2025年，其整体业务录得43亿美元的亏损。

sentences.en: And that has put a financial strain on SpaceX's IPO documents.
sentences.zh: 这给SpaceX的IPO文件带来了财务压力。

sentences.en: Okay, so basically, AI is costing SpaceX so much money that when you look at the overall bottom line, including the profitability of Starlink, SpaceX is losing money somehow.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以基本上，人工智能让SpaceX花费了如此多的资金，以至于当你审视整体盈亏时，包括星链的盈利能力在内，SpaceX在某种程度上是在亏钱的。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I should say that there are other factors beyond AI.
sentences.zh: 我应该说，除了人工智能之外还有其他因素。

sentences.en: It's incredibly expensive to build these rockets.
sentences.zh: 制造这些火箭极其昂贵。

sentences.en: The company's also looking to build something called Starship, which is the rocket they believe will bring people to Mars.
sentences.zh: 公司还在寻求建造一种名为“星舰”（Starship）的东西，他们相信这种火箭能将人类送往火星。

sentences.en: But AI right now is the millstone around the company's knack.
sentences.zh: 但目前人工智能是拖累公司发展的沉重负担。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, a company that's 20 years old losing money over a full year makes it hard, at least for me, to understand how you get to an overall valuation of $1.25 trillion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一家成立20年的公司全年都在亏损，这让我很难理解它是如何达到1.25万亿美元的总估值的。

sentences.en: There are several companies in our economy that are valued at $1 trillion, but they are hugely profitable, like thinking of NVIDIA or Microsoft.
sentences.zh: 我们的经济中有几家公司估值达到1万亿美元，但它们都非常赚钱，比如英伟达或微软。

sentences.en: So how does SpaceX get to that number?
sentences.zh: 那么SpaceX是如何达到那个数字的呢？

sentences.en: Well, it's saying it's going to do all these things in the future.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它声称未来要做所有这些事情。

sentences.en: It's going to put data centers into space.
sentences.zh: 它要在太空中建立数据中心。

sentences.en: It's going to build factories on the moon.
sentences.zh: 它要在月球上建造工厂。

sentences.en: It's going to land people on Mars.
sentences.zh: 它要将人类送上火星。

sentences.en: And essentially what investors are betting on is not the current fundamentals of the company, but you're betting on the future.
sentences.zh: 本质上，投资者押注的不是公司当前的经营基本面，而是在押注未来。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the future that he's promising sounds extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 他承诺的未来听起来非同寻常。

sentences.en: But I wonder how, if you're a mom and pop investor, literally, if you're my mom or my dad,
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，如果你是一个普通散户投资者，字面意思上，如果你是我妈或我爸，

sentences.en: how are you supposed to judge whether buying into this IPO through Charles Schwab or an index fund actually makes sense if that valuation feels realistic?
sentences.zh: 你怎么去判断通过嘉信理财（Charles Schwab）或指数基金购买这个IPO是否真的有意义，如果那个估值感觉很现实的话？

sentences.en: And that's where I think the evaluation of this company as like a traditional stock goes out the window.
sentences.zh: 这就是我认为将这家公司视为传统股票进行评估完全行不通的地方。

sentences.en: You know, you're not doing your traditional analyses of shares or financials here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你在这里做的不是传统的股票或财务分析。

sentences.en: A lot of this is simply hype.
sentences.zh: 这其中很大一部分纯粹是炒作。

sentences.en: And I say that looking at a number that the company put out in their own document, something called total addressable market.
sentences.zh: 我说这话是基于公司在他们自己的文件中发布的一个数字，即所谓的“潜在市场总额”（TAM）。

sentences.en: This is the market that the company projects it will be able to attain in the future.
sentences.zh: 这是公司预测其未来能够达到的市场规模。

sentences.en: And it estimated in its own financial documents that its total addressable market is the largest ever in human history and that it estimates it to be $28.5 trillion.
sentences.zh: 它在自己的财务文件中估计，其潜在市场总额是人类历史上最大的，估计为28.5万亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Put that number in a context.
sentences.zh: 把这个数字放在背景中来看。

sentences.en: I don't know if I can.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我能不能做到。

sentences.en: I mean, it's so massive.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它太庞大了。

sentences.en: It's close to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它接近美国的

sentences.en: GDP, I believe.
sentences.zh: GDP，我想是这样。

sentences.en: And the company is telling investors that if you invest in us, we may become a company that controls a market that is $28.5 trillion.
sentences.zh: 公司在告诉投资者，如果你投资我们，我们可能会成为一家控制着28.5万亿美元市场的公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That basically does the kind of commerce that the entirety of the United States economy does.
sentences.zh: 那基本上就是从事整个美国经济所做的那种商业活动。

sentences.en: Someday.
sentences.zh: 总有一天。

sentences.en: Yeah, someday.
sentences.zh: 是的，总有一天。

sentences.en: And that is AI and rockets to space and Starlink and all that is $28.5 trillion.
sentences.zh: 这就是人工智能、太空火箭、星链等等，总计28.5万亿美元。

sentences.en: That's the type of hype that Elon Musk is able to sell.
sentences.zh: 这就是埃隆·马斯克能够兜售的那种炒作。

sentences.en: And I think people buy into that largely because he's been successful in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 我认为人们之所以买账，很大程度上是因为他过去很成功。

sentences.en: You look at, you know, his net worth, for example, which can fluctuate anywhere from $600 to $800 billion these days.
sentences.zh: 你看，比如他的净资产，这些天可以在6000亿到8000亿美元之间波动。

sentences.en: And you might see that and be like, well, this man's been very successful.
sentences.zh: 你可能会看到这一点，然后觉得，嗯，这个人非常成功。

sentences.en: And he's telling me he's going to hit these trillion dollars in total addressable market.
sentences.zh: 而且他告诉我他将达到这28.5万亿美元的潜在市场总额。

sentences.en: Let me put my faith into him and let me bet on him because he seems to be going places.
sentences.zh: 让我把信任寄托在他身上，让我押注于他，因为他似乎前途无量。

sentences.en: Well, let me put that proposition to the teSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我来检验一下这个命题。

sentences.en: Elon Musk's track record in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克过去的业绩记录。

sentences.en: Quickly summarize it.
sentences.zh: 快速总结一下。

sentences.en: We have a couple of examples to play with.
sentences.zh: 我们有几个例子可以探讨。

sentences.en: Obviously, we have Tesla.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们有特斯拉。

sentences.en: We also have X, formerly known as Twitter.
sentences.zh: 我们还有X，前身为推特。

sentences.en: So let's take Tesla.
sentences.zh: 那么我们来看看特斯拉。

sentences.en: He took the company public and the company has mainstreamed electric cars around the world.
sentences.zh: 他让公司上市，并且该公司使电动汽车在世界范围内成为主流。

sentences.en: It has been wildly successful from a stock price perspective.
sentences.zh: 从股价角度来看，它取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: It's made folks a lot of money and it continues to be a strong public company from a stock price perspective.
sentences.zh: 它让人们赚了很多钱，而且从股价角度来看，它仍然是一家强大的上市公司。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so have investors.
sentences.zh: 投资者也是如此。

sentences.en: I mean, I think I was looking up before we spoke that if you invested $1,000 in Tesla at its initial public offering, you'd have something like a quarter million dollars today.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想在我们交谈之前查了一下，如果你在特斯拉首次公开募股时投资了1000美元，今天你将拥有大约25万美元。

sentences.en: That is a hell of a return.
sentences.zh: 那真是惊人的回报。

sentences.en: And I think that's, you know, part of the appeal of Musk and the part of the appeal of so much of this hype around him.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是马斯克的吸引力所在，也是围绕他的这么多炒作的吸引力所在。

sentences.en: But also, I covered his acquisition of Twitter back in 2022, which was not- And that is not as much of a success.
sentences.zh: 但我也报道过他2022年对推特的收购，那并不是——那并不算太成功。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: You know, he bought that company at $44 billion.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他以440亿美元收购了那家公司。

sentences.en: At one point, the valuation of the company, as marked down by some of his investors, was
sentences.zh: 一度，该公司被他的一些投资者减记后的估值只有

sentences.en: $10 billion, but he was able to rescue that company by merging it with, at the time, his
sentences.zh: 100亿美元，但他通过将其与当时他的人工智能公司xAI合并，成功拯救了那家公司。

sentences.en: AI company, XAI.
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管那家公司在财务上并不成功，但他能够将其埋在自己的人工智能公司中，而后者在筹集资金方面在纸面上相当成功。

sentences.en: And so even though that company has not been a financial success, he's been able to bury that within his AI company, which on paper was quite the success in terms of raising money.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 这确实指出了一个事实，即对于像埃隆·马斯克这样的人来说，风险甚至不是正常的风险，因为他能够利用他业务的一个分支，在这种情况下，去拯救另一个分支。

sentences.en: Which I guess does point to the fact that risk isn't even normal risk with someone like Elon Musk, because he's able to use one arm of his business to, in this case, rescue
sentences.zh: 如果你是投资了X的人，你现在还好吗？

sentences.en: another.
sentences.zh: 你很好。

sentences.en: And if you're someone who invested in X, are you doing okay now?
sentences.zh: 因为如果你是他在推特收购案中的投资者，你现在大概持有SpaceX的股份。

sentences.en: You are.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在的日子过得相当不错。

sentences.en: Because if you were an investor in his Twitter takeover, you now presumably hold
sentences.zh: 所以当你思考风险，思考像埃隆·马斯克这样的人的问责制时，游戏规则完全不同。

sentences.en: SpaceX shares.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So you're doing quite well for yourself.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下你为什么在这里提出SpaceX和马斯克的问责问题。

sentences.en: And so you think about risk and you think about accountability for someone like Elon Musk and the rules of the game are just completely different.
sentences.zh: 因为对于大多数上市公司来说，上市公司的CEO要对股东负责。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 这些股东拥有投票权。

sentences.en: Just explain why you're raising the issue of accountability here for SpaceX and Musk.
sentences.zh: 如果一家公司表现不好，他们可以投票反对他们的CEO，或者向董事会施压，要求对CEO采取行动。

sentences.en: Because with most public companies, public CEOs are accountable to their shareholders.
sentences.zh: 或者在某些情况下，如果他们认为CEO或其他高管做了不当行为，可以提起股东诉讼。

sentences.en: These shareholders have votes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And if a company doesn't do well, they can vote against their
sentences.zh: 或者，例如，如果公司的估值不再与股东被承诺的情况有任何相似之处。

sentences.en: CEO or pressure the board to take action against the CEO.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or in some cases, file shareholder lawsuits if they believe something untoward has been done by the CEO or other executives.
sentences.zh: 而埃隆·马斯克在SpaceX的这个案例中所做的是，移除了许多问责机制。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我看看他在公司拥有的权力大小。

sentences.en: Or if, for example, the company's valuation no longer bears any resemblance to what shareholders were promised.
sentences.zh: 他建立了我们所谓的超级投票权股份，在这种情况下，他持有的股份与你的普通股相比，拥有10比1的投票权。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他拥有公司近85%的投票控制权。

sentences.en: And what Elon Musk has done in this case at SpaceX is remove a lot of the levers for accountability.
sentences.zh: 他拥有这种令人难以置信的超级多数，基本上拥有不受挑战的权力。

sentences.en: I look at the amount of power he has in the company.
sentences.zh: 他控制着董事会。

sentences.en: He has instituted what we call super voting shares, where the shares he holds have, in this case, 10 to 1 votes compared to your average share.
sentences.zh: 他任命了朋友和合伙人进入董事会。

sentences.en: He has almost 85% of the voting control in the company.
sentences.zh: 基本上，他可以在没有任何挑战的情况下统治公司。

sentences.en: He has this incredible super majority where he essentially has unchallenged power.
sentences.zh: 股东们基本上没有办法发起任何形式的反抗或干预，即使公司的表现非常糟糕。

sentences.en: He controls the board.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He has appointed friends and associates to the board.
sentences.zh: 和埃隆在一起，你基本上就是要么大赚，要么大赔。

sentences.en: And essentially, he gets to rule the company without any challenge.
sentences.zh: 你提出的问责问题，我认为，特别让我们回到了马斯克这个不可避免的问题，以及正如你所说，SpaceX实际上是对他、他的愿景、他的判断、他过去的业绩记录的投资。

sentences.en: There's no way for shareholders to essentially stage any kind of revolt or intervention, even if the company's performance is quite bad.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些业绩记录表明，总的来说，如果你投资马斯克，你很可能会赢，但过去几年对他行为的质疑已经引起了人们的关注。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 他曾试图在特朗普总统的第二个任期内通过Doge（政府效率部）削减政府开支，但失败了。

sentences.en: You're kind of, with Elon, up or down.
sentences.zh: 而且马斯克确实从特斯拉身上分心了，对吧？

sentences.en: The accountability issues you're raising in particular, I think, bring us back to this
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他和特朗普发生了巨大的争执，据我记忆，这几乎导致特朗普威胁要取消他通过SpaceX获得的合同。

sentences.en: inevitable question of Musk and how SpaceX, as you said, is really an investment in him, his vision, his judgments, his past track record.
sentences.zh: 我们在这里的同事在《纽约时报》的报道中也提出了关于他吸毒的问题。

sentences.en: And while that track record suggests that in general, you're going to win if you invest with Musk, the past few years have raised meaningful questions about his conduct.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是一个传统的CEO，这既是吸引力的一部分，显然也是风险的一部分。

sentences.en: He went off to go try to reduce government spending under the second term of
sentences.zh: 他离职去尝试在特朗普的第二个任期内通过“政府效率部”（DOGE）削减政府开支，但失败了。

sentences.en: President Trump through Doge, and that failed.
sentences.zh: 而马斯克也因此严重分心，尤其是对特斯拉的关注度下降了，对吧？

sentences.en: And Musk got really distracted from Tesla, especially, right?
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他和特朗普爆发了激烈的冲突，据我回忆，这差点导致特朗普威胁要取消他SpaceX的合同。

sentences.en: And at the same time, he got into a huge fight with Trump that almost resulted in
sentences.zh: 此外，我们《纽约时报》的同事在报道中也对他使用药物的问题提出了质疑。

sentences.en: Trump threatening his contracts through SpaceX, as I recall.
sentences.zh: 所以，他并非一位传统的首席执行官，这既是他魅力的一部分，显然也是风险的一部分。

sentences.en: There's also questions about his use of drugs raised in reporting by our colleagues here at The Times.
sentences.zh: 他离职去尝试在特朗普的第二个任期内通过“政府效率部”（DOGE）削减政府开支，但失败了。

sentences.en: So this is not a traditional CEO, which is part of the allure, but it's also clearly part of the risk.
sentences.zh: 而马斯克也因此严重分心，尤其是对特斯拉的关注度下降了，对吧？

sentences.en: And from what you're saying, none of the normal accountability mechanisms are in place if he starts to go off the rails.
sentences.zh: 照你所说，如果他开始失控，现有的常规问责机制似乎都无法发挥作用。

sentences.en: So how should we think about that as a risk in this all?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们该如何看待这其中的风险呢？

sentences.en: I mean, that should be the top-line risk for anyone thinking of investing in any of his companies, that Elon Musk is a singular figure, good or bad.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于任何考虑投资他旗下公司的人来说，这都应该是首要风险，因为埃隆·马斯克是一个独特的人物，无论好坏。

sentences.en: And I think that is something I think about a lot, this individual who has that much power, that much wealth, who is essentially unaccountable here.
sentences.zh: 我经常思考这个问题：这个拥有如此巨大权力和财富的个人，本质上却不受任何约束。

sentences.en: And he's unaccountable because of that wealth.
sentences.zh: 而他之所以不受约束，正是因为他拥有这些财富。

sentences.en: And so when you think about this SpaceX IPO and the potential for what it can do to his net worth to potentially make him a trillionaire, this could give him even more power.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你想到 SpaceX 的首次公开募股（IPO），以及它可能让他的净资产增加到万亿级别时，这可能会赋予他更大的权力。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I guess the way to think about this IPO is that one way or another, we're even more bound up with Musk's success or failure than we have ever been before.
sentences.zh: 我想，看待这次 IPO 的方式是：无论如何，我们与马斯克的成败比以往任何时候都更加紧密地捆绑在一起了。

sentences.en: I mean, if he goes up with this IPO, we all go up with him for all the reasons we've talked about, including especially the index funds.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他通过这次 IPO 飞黄腾达，我们所有人都会因为我们讨论过的所有原因，尤其是指数基金的原因，随他一起水涨船高。

sentences.en: And if he goes down a ton, we all go down with him.
sentences.zh: 而如果他跌入谷底，我们所有人也会随他一起坠落。

sentences.en: We are all tied to Musk, whether we want to be or not.
sentences.zh: 无论我们是否愿意，我们都与马斯克捆绑在了一起。

sentences.en: And that's just the story right now of the economy he's created.
sentences.zh: 这就是他所创造的经济体系目前的现状。

sentences.en: Yeah, there's really no way off the rocket ship.
sentences.zh: 是的，真的没有办法从这艘火箭上下来了。

sentences.en: And I think there's an argument to be made that this
sentences.zh: 我认为有一种观点认为，这次

sentences.en: IPO could go well.
sentences.zh: IPO 可能会进展顺利。

sentences.en: It could make a lot of money for folks.
sentences.zh: 它能为人们赚到不少钱。

sentences.en: And in the short term, it could sustain on this hype alone.
sentences.zh: 短期内，它可能仅凭这种炒作就能维持下去。

sentences.en: But in the long term, this is now going to be a public company.
sentences.zh: 但从长远来看，这现在将成为一家上市公司。

sentences.en: It's going to have financial results it's going to disclose.
sentences.zh: 它将会有需要披露的财务业绩。

sentences.en: It's going to have quarterly earnings calls with investors.
sentences.zh: 它将会有与投资者进行的季度财报电话会议。

sentences.en: And it's going to need to show progress towards these very lofty goals that people have already invested in.
sentences.zh: 它将需要展示在这些人们已经投资的宏伟目标上所取得的进展。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Whether that's putting data centers into space or getting people to Mars.
sentences.zh: 无论是将数据中心送入太空，还是将人类送往火星。

sentences.en: And if the company and Elon Musk doesn't show that progress, investors may start to get antsy.
sentences.zh: 如果公司和埃隆·马斯克无法展示出这些进展，投资者可能会开始感到不安。

sentences.en: And while he is largely unaccountable, investors do have one main way to show their displeasure, which is to sell the stock.
sentences.zh: 虽然他很大程度上不受约束，但投资者确实有一种主要方式来表达他们的不满，那就是抛售股票。

sentences.en: And if that's the case, you know, there'll be potentially a reckoning for SpaceX and for Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 如果真是这样，你知道，SpaceX 和埃隆·马斯克可能会面临清算。

sentences.en: And this rocket ship that SpaceX has taken off on, that we're all aboard, could come crashing back down to Earth.
sentences.zh: 而 SpaceX 已经起飞、我们所有人都身处其中的这艘火箭，可能会重重地坠回地球。

sentences.en: Well, Ryan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，瑞安，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has intervened to block the promotion of top officials inside the U.S.
sentences.zh: 据《泰晤士报》报道，国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯已介入，阻止了美国海军内部高级官员的晋升，

sentences.en: Navy, an unusual move that disproportionately targets women and minority officers.
sentences.zh: 这一不同寻常的举动对女性和少数族裔军官造成了不成比例的影响。

sentences.en: At least two of the officers removed by Hegseth from the promotion list are Black men, and two others are women.
sentences.zh: 在被赫格塞斯从晋升名单中除名的军官中，至少有两名是黑人男性，另外两名是女性。

sentences.en: As a result, no female officers were included on the new list of one-star officers, despite the fact that women make up 21% of the active-duty Navy.
sentences.zh: 结果，尽管女性占现役海军的 21%，但新的准将名单中却没有任何女性军官。

sentences.en: And the White House sent signals on Monday that it was backing away from a planned fund to compensate victims of government weaponization.
sentences.zh: 白宫周一发出信号，表示正在放弃一项旨在补偿政府武器化受害者的计划基金。

sentences.en: The Justice Department said it would abide by a federal court ruling from last week, directing it not to work on setting up the fund.
sentences.zh: 司法部表示，将遵守上周联邦法院的裁决，即不得致力于设立该基金。

sentences.en: That's leading some to conclude that the White House is retreating from the idea amid intense blowback from courts and Congress, including congressional Republicans.
sentences.zh: 这导致一些人得出结论，在来自法院和国会（包括国会共和党人）的强烈反对下，白宫正在撤回这一想法。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由瑞奇·内维茨基、杰克·德西多尔和罗谢尔·邦贾制作。

sentences.zh: 由布伦丹·

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由

sentences.zh: Wonderly 创作。

sentences.zh: 本期节目由艾丽莎·莫克斯利担任音频工程。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·博瓦罗。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine, until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称为改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场痛苦、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《地铁》的最新一期节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
